annotations.title: NFIP paid building claims by county

description: NFIP paid building claims for one county, 2015-2024 and 2020-2024. Give a 5-digit FIPS code, or a county name and its state. A county absent from the table (it keeps counties with at least 100 paid claims) gets the state row, and the answer says so. These are amounts paid by NFIP, not repair cost.

county.description: County name, e.g. Harris County (needs state)

state.description: Two-letter code or state name, with county
